SEASON 9 · REGULAR SEASON WRAP-UP · NOVEMBER 21

THE ROAD TO THE PLAYOFFS IS SET

The regular-season results are in. The playoff matchups and seeds are featured in the playoff brackets above.

November 21 delivered a full slate of decisive results. All nine games available in the latest iTala book are now included in the scores, standings, and team statistics. Player box scores are available for eight of them; the Quolos Construction–L2G result is recorded as a 0–30 final without individual player statistics.

BAMBHORATS FINISH UNDEFEATED

Bambhorats Knights defeated JMC Alliance 62–55 to complete a 7–0 Open Division campaign. Haides X Journey finished 6–1 after a 109–58 win over Dentio Dental.

BIG RESULTS ACROSS THE OPEN DIVISION

Epic Grill Silogs edged Wild Tribe 75–72; Slytherin beat Fitman Hunter 50–42; Pipers defeated Gentlemen's Club 87–61; and Sando Republika won against Silent Threat 84–77.

BALIKLARO 35+ FINISHES STRONG

Bisdak 35+ beat Pipers 35+ 62–42 to finish 5–1, while Bambhorats Knights 35+ defeated JMC Alliance 35+ 89–62. The most recent report does not include a result for Salty Crew 35+ vs FRP 35+, so it is not assumed.

PLAYOFFS START NOVEMBER 28

Open Division positions 1–8 are assigned to Division 1 and positions 9–12 to Division 2 under the stated league format. See the Playoff Brackets tab for the posted matchups and seed placements across all divisions.
